name: Detail Threshing (Web)
implementation_notes: Reuses ThreshingRecordService::getDetail() (BE service shared with screen-049, see that screen's implement artifact for the service/controller/route files)

Target Operasional table queried DIRECTLY by DetailThreshing::render() (ThreshingOperationalTarget::orderBy('sort_order')->get()) -- NOT part of the GET /api/threshing-records/{id} response -- per explicit tech-spec direction, mirrors the mobile Data Preview screen's static-constant approach conceptually but reads live from DB since web has no offline concern

Field grouping/order in the Blade view mirrors mobile/src/views/DataPreviewThreshingView.vue's detail mode exactly (Thresher ID, Tanggal, Inputted By, Checked By, Acknowledged By, Note, grid, Target Operasional table), per explicit product direction that web station screens mirror mobile flow/UX
Route /data/threshing/{id} registered after /data/threshing/create (screen-057) so the literal 'create' segment is not swallowed by {id}

REVISED 2026-08-24 (documentation-only correction, no functional code change needed): the Blade view (detail-threshing.blade.php) already iterated `$record['details']` directly with a plain @foreach and never assumed exactly 24 rows, so it required zero changes for the entity-catalog v12 dynamic-add-row revision to ThreshingRecordService -- it correctly renders however many rows a record actually has

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): aksi verifikasi langsung di layar Detail (approve/un-approve, 2026-09-14) sebelumnya TIDAK terdokumentasi sama sekali di artefak ini. backend/app/Livewire/Data/DetailThreshing.php memakai trait backend/app/Livewire/Data/Concerns/HandlesRecordVerification.php (verificationModelClass()=ThreshingRecord::class) dan blade-nya merender aksi lewat canCheck()/canAcknowledge() + :message=$verificationMessage — Checked By (Supervisor/Admin) dan Acknowledged By (Mill Management/Admin). Aksi memanggil backend/app/Services/RecordVerificationService.php::setVerification() (jalur tulis keempat): peran -> cakupan mill (403) -> assertPeriodOpenForWrite('threshing', mill stasiun record, `date` record) -> 422 PERIOD_CLOSED sebelum kolom berubah -> baru tulis checked_by/acknowledged_by. Sejak fix 0594c63 HandlesRecordVerification menangkap HttpException sehingga penolakan periode tampil sebagai alert $verificationMessage (sebelumnya 422 mentah). Padanan API: PATCH /api/records/{stationType}/{id}/verification (RecordVerificationController). Diuji: backend/tests/Feature/Livewire/DetailRecordVerificationTest.php ('kunci periode: ...'; trait bersama, diwakili DetailCagesTrack), backend/tests/Feature/Api/RecordVerificationTest.php (422 PERIOD_CLOSED setujui & batalkan), backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php (aturan whitelist).
